Name: SOUND_CUTSCENE_PARAM_ST
Description: Sound settings for cutscenes. The row ID is the cutscene ID (the ID played by the event, e.g. 10000020). A cutscene without a row uses reverb type 0 and no end sound.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on most rows, which work normally).

Fields.Name: Reverb Type
Fields.Description: Reverb type used while the cutscene plays. Overrides the map's default reverb and the automatic reverb (same type numbers as MapDefaultInfoParam and SoundAutoReverbSelectParam). Retail: 1 for most cutscenes, 5 for the underground (m12), 6 for some m21 cutscenes.

Fields.Name: BGM Behaviour on Start
Fields.Description: Read when the cutscene starts and handed to the BGM handler; what each value does was not traced. Retail: 2 for almost every cutscene, 0 for 10 (row 0, 10000050, 20010010, 35000010/20, 60500000, 90000010, 90009999, 99999901/2).

Fields.Name: One-Shot BGM Behaviour on Start
Fields.Description: Read when the cutscene starts: 1 and 2 switch the one-shot BGM state off and on (the state is reset when the cutscene ends); any other value leaves it unchanged. The audible effect was not traced. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: End Sound ID
Fields.Description: Sound (category p) played when the cutscene ends normally. -1: none.

Fields.Name: End Sound ID (Skipped)
Fields.Description: Sound (category p) played instead of End Sound ID when the player skips the cutscene. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Map Entry Mute - Lift After Seconds
Fields.Description: When the cutscene plays while the sound is still muted from entering the map, the mute is lifted after the cutscene has been showing for this many seconds. Below 0: the cutscene doesn't lift it. Retail: 1, or -1 for 27 rows.

Fields.Name: Ignore BGM Stop After End
Fields.Description: Seconds, read when the cutscene ends: values above 0 are kept for the BGM handler, meant to keep the BGM from being stopped for this long after the cutscene (the handler wasn't traced). 0 or less: off. Retail: -1 on every row.
